answer: The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in river, expire in anchor, and glacier lists each expiry. Anyone running 136 aliases therefore needs 192 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4992 identities would post 2181 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
